symbols.name: edge matrix
symbols.meaning: The matrix attached to edge e, the difference of the matrices at its endpoints.
symbols.quote: Each edge $e$ has a matrix $A_e$, the difference of its endpoint matrices.

symbols.name: exclusive or
symbols.meaning: Addition over the binary field, applied bit by bit.
symbols.quote: Over the binary field, addition is exclusive or ($\oplus$), taken bit by bit.

symbols.name: capped log exponent
symbols.meaning: The capped logarithm max(0, log_m(s/W)) of s/W, which is below tau.
symbols.quote: Let $\theta=\max(0,\log_m(s/W))$ be the capped logarithm of $s/W$, which is below $\tau$.

relations.quote: It performs an [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) by a shear over the binary field, and the recursion in [Rank-saving recursion](rank-saving-recursion.md) uses it as a cheap field interchange.

relations.predicate: is the first of the two
relations.quote: The bit procedure is the first of the two [tape procedures](tape-procedure.md) that move address fields of an array.
The cost of the procedure is measured by its [running time cost](running-time-cost.md).
The bit procedure counts its interchanges by the [matrix rank](matrix-rank.md) of each edge matrix.
